title: areas outside of the mall mimic areas i know irl
content: i don't know if this can even be considered mall world but there is a mall, so i'm posting it here. all of my dreams mimic areas of the town i live in.. last night i was kidnapped and after i escaped, i ended up at where i thought was an area that we call mansion park in real life.. i asked a guy where i was and he goes "center city" ..i then tried to use his phone to tell someone where i was but as usual, cell phones never work in my dreams and it's always incredibly frustrating. i guess my question is does anyone else ever experience this? i always see posts about you guys going to coastal towns and different places but 99% of the time i'm in a weird ass version of the town i live in. i can get to the mall, but it's also my local mall on the outside. if i go anywhere else, i never remember.
